sources.name: gale_plate
sources.prompt: Production texture for an original Minecraft Java mod mob: one small flat armor plate front, shown head-on, completely fills the rectangular canvas. EXACTLY 5 pixels wide and 8 pixels tall in logical pixel art, enlarged with crisp nearest neighbor square pixels. Vanilla Minecraft Breeze family palette: muted purplish blue (#7776a3), dusty violet shadow (#525171), pale grey lilac edge (#b0acc4). A narrow one-pixel pale border around a solid muted purple field, only two or three small shade patches; four or five colors total, chunky plain texels. No gold, no gem, no engraving, no bevel gradient, no 3D perspective, no realistic metal, no fine noise, no text, no margins. This is an original shield material used on four rectangular floating plates, not a picture of a creature. Opaque surface edge to edge.
